title: Order
noCode: Scan the QR code on the table to read the menu and order.
codeInvalid: This QR code no longer works. Please ask our staff.
sessionEnded: This ordering session has ended. Scan the QR code on the table again.
tableClosed: The table is not open yet. You can read the menu; ask our staff to open the table to order.
approvalStaff: Staff confirm each order before it goes to the kitchen.
approvalDirect: Small orders go straight to the kitchen; larger ones wait for staff.
menuEmpty: Nothing can be ordered by QR yet.
cartEmpty: Your cart is empty. Pick dishes from the menu.
cartPriceNote: Menu prices; the final price is confirmed when you pay.
cartTooManyLines: Send at most {{max}} lines at once.
cartTooManyItems: Send at most {{max}} items at once.
sent: Order sent. Follow it under My table.
timedNote: Play time is charged up to the moment you pay.
requestOpen_call_staff: Staff have been called and are on their way.
requestOpen_request_bill: The bill is on its way.
error_network: No connection. Check the shop's Wi-Fi and try again.
error_rate_limited: A little too fast. Wait a minute and try again.
error_table_closed: The table is not open or was closed. Please ask our staff.
error_item_sold_out: An item just sold out. Remove it from the cart and send again.
error_item_unavailable: An item can no longer be ordered. Remove it and send again.
error_too_many_pending: You have 3 orders waiting. Wait for staff to confirm them first.
error_modifier_min: An item is missing a choice.
error_modifier_max: An item has too many choices.
error_modifier_unknown: An item's choices changed. Pick that item again.
error_guest_order_invalid: The order is not valid. Check the cart.
error_unknown: Could not send. Try again in a few minutes.
